question: In the flue gas of the hydrate-based CO2 capture simulation in the hydrate CCUS review, what are the CO2 mole fraction and its feed rate in kmol/h?
rendered:
According to the excerpt from "Recent Advances in Hydrate-Based CO2 Capture: Energy Consumption, Cost Analysis, Policy Perspectives, and Machine Learning-Driven Simulation of CO2 Hydrate Formation" on page 5, the composition of the flue gas is listed in Table 3 as follows:

component | mole fraction | molar mass (g/mol) | feed rate (kmol/h) | feed rate (t/h)
---------|---------------|---------------------|-------------------|-------------
CO2      | 0.19           | 44                  | 7143              | 314
N2       | 0.71           | 28                  | 31,697             | 1,388

So, the CO2 mole fraction is 0.19 and its feed rate in kmol/h is 7143.
